title: Patient-Specific Compounded Sterile Preparation Order Form

opciones: Semaglutide 5 mg/mL / Cyanocobalamin 0.4 mg/mL (2 mL vial)
Tirzepatide 12.5 mg/mL / Pyridoxine HCl 10 mg/mL (5 mL vial)

items.texto: Documented allergy, hypersensitivity, or clinically significant intolerance to a specific inactive ingredient in the identified commercial product.
Patient requires an individualized dose or titration increment not available in the identified commercial presentation.
Patient has a documented physical or functional limitation preventing use of the commercially available delivery device:
Motor/dexterity impairment
Patient requires a preservative-free single-dose presentation for the following documented clinical reason:
Patient requires a patient-specific multidose vial or alternative container-closure system for the following documented clinical reason:
Laboratory-confirmed cyanocobalamin deficiency requiring medically necessary parenteral replacement. Laboratory results and dates
Laboratory-confirmed pyridoxine deficiency requiring medically necessary replacement. Laboratory results and dates
The prescriber has evaluated total weekly pyridoxine exposure and potential pyridoxine-associated sensory neuropathy.
Other documented patient-specific clinical justification:

secciones.intro: The prescriber confirms that the following were reviewed and addressed as clinically appropriate:

items.texto: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma and MEN 2.
Pregnancy, planned pregnancy, and breastfeeding status.
History of pancreatitis or gallbladder disease.
Severe gastroparesis or other significant gastrointestinal disease.
Renal function, dehydration risk, and relevant laboratory monitoring.
Concurrent insulin, sulfonylurea, or other hypoglycemia-producing therapy.
Concurrent GLP-1, GIP/GLP-1, or similar incretin therapy.
Prior hypersensitivity to semaglutide, tirzepatide, or formulation components.
Appropriateness of starting dose, frequency, and titration schedule.
Patient counseling regarding dosing, measurement, storage, refrigeration, missed doses, and adverse effects.

secciones.texto: I certify that this prescription is issued for an individually identified patient based on my professional medical judgment and a documented patient-specific clinical need. I have evaluated the applicable FDA-approved commercial product and determined that the specific change described above produces a significant difference for this patient. I will maintain the supporting clinical justification in the patient's medical record. I assume clinical responsibility for patient selection, diagnosis, dose, route, frequency, titration, duration, monitoring, contraindication, counseling, and management of adverse events.
